sentences.text: Heard learned counsel, Mr. M. Khan for the petitioners (i) Sukur Ali and (ii) Kader Ali.

Page No.# 2/3 Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186799059/
1 2.

This application has been filed by the petitioners under Section 438 of the Cr.PC with prayer for pre-arrest bail as they are apprehending arrest in connection with Manikpur P.S. Case No. 69/2024 under Sections 420/376/493/370 of the IPC.
3.
Heard Mr. R. R. Kaushik, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the respondent State.
4. The allegation against the petitioners is that they sold the victim 'X' in Delhi.
5. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that a false case has been initiated against both the petitioners.
6. The victim went away with Sukur Ali on her own volition.
It has been falsely alleged that she has been sold in Delhi.
She used to work in Delhi.
7. After she has returned from Delhi, she has slammed a false case against both the petitioners.
8. I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection.
9. I have also scrutinized the Case Diary.
10. It appears that investigation has progressed to a considerable extent.
11. It also appears that custodial interrogation may not be required.
12. It appears that anticipatory bail may be granted to the petitioners.
Page No.# 3/3 13.
The petitioners have pledged to co-operate with the remaining part of the investigation.
They are local residents and are not flight risks.
14. In view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.
On breach of any of the bail conditions, bail order shall stand cancelled.
